openRoles.title: React.js Frontend Engineer
openRoles.overview: Looking for a seasoned React developer who cares deeply about UI craftsmanship, responsive layouts, performance optimization, and modular component architecture.
responsibilities: Develop high-performance, accessible user interfaces using React.js, Tailwind CSS, and modern JavaScript.
Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate RESTful and WebSocket APIs seamlessly.
Optimize Core Web Vitals, page rendering speeds, and cross-browser reliability.
Maintain clean component documentation and reusable design libraries.
requirements: Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React hooks, and component lifecycle.
Deep understanding of responsive layout systems, Tailwind CSS, and CSS modern standards.
Experience with state management and REST API integration.
Familiarity with Git workflows and frontend performance profiling.

openRoles.title: Node.js Backend Engineer
openRoles.overview: Architect and build high-throughput REST APIs, database schemas, and microservices powering enterprise client applications.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable REST APIs using Node.js and Express.
Design efficient database schemas, indexes, and queries in PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB.
Implement robust authentication (JWT, OAuth2, RBAC) and rate-limiting safeguards.
Write clean unit and integration tests to ensure data consistency.
requirements: Solid hands-on experience building production APIs with Node.js.
Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases and query optimization.
Proficiency in asynchronous event-loop programming and error handling.
Familiarity with Docker containerization and Linux environments.

openRoles.title: Full Stack Developer
openRoles.overview: Bridge frontend elegance with backend resilience to deliver complete end-to-end features for web and enterprise platforms.
responsibilities: Own feature development from database schema design to frontend UI implementation.
Ensure seamless data flow, state synchronization, and secure communications.
Participate in architectural reviews and mentor junior team members.
requirements: Demonstrated experience with React.js, Node.js, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
Solid grasp of API security, caching layers (Redis), and cloud hosting basics.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

openRoles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst / VAPT Engineer
openRoles.overview: Perform authorized security assessments, vulnerability scans, web application security audits, and support client remediation efforts.
responsibilities: Conduct authorized vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on web apps, APIs, and networks.
Map findings against OWASP Top 10, CWE, and CVSS severity standards.
Draft comprehensive technical reports with step-by-step remediation guidance.
Assist development teams with re-testing and vulnerability verification.
requirements: Practical experience with security assessment tools (Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, etc.).
Deep understanding of web vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, IDOR/BOLA, SSRF).
Knowledge of SSL/TLS configurations, HTTP security headers, and network protocols.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CEH, eJPT, OSCP, or equivalent) are a strong plus.

openRoles.title: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
openRoles.overview: Automate cloud deployments, orchestrate Docker containers, configure monitoring systems, and maintain high server availability.
responsibilities: Maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS and hardened Linux servers.
Implement automated backups, disaster recovery, and infrastructure telemetry.
Tune web servers (Nginx), reverse proxies, and caching layers.
requirements: Hands-on experience with Linux administration (Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL).
Proficiency in Docker, container networking, and Docker Compose.
Experience configuring AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM).
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) is advantageous.

openRoles.title: UI/UX Product Designer
openRoles.overview: Design intuitive user flows, sleek enterprise dashboards, and modern digital brand identities that delight users and drive conversions.
responsibilities: Create wireframes, user journeys, interactive Figma prototypes, and design systems.
Translate complex technical workflows into clean, accessible user interfaces.
Collaborate closely with frontend engineers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.
requirements: Strong portfolio showcasing web and mobile interface designs.
Mastery of Figma, auto-layout, design tokens, and prototyping.
Strong aesthetic sense for typography, color theory, and responsive layouts.
